item.title: Co-inference 0.1.0-preview.15
item.description: Literature reviews now produce a separate bibliography-style deliverable for each agent, with an explicit explanation of how each source relates to the original input. Full-text PDF and HTML reading includes verifiable passages and PDF page images. Saved review progress survives retries. Existing research checkpoints remain supported. Requires the published Brain workflow 0.32.0 for the new review requirements.
